answer: The grove counter is kept in summit and garden shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 295 aliases cost 361 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
